get.summary: List YouTube RSS items
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of YouTube RSS entries with an optional text search and typed filters.

### Sorting Behavior:
- Default sort: `pubDate,desc`.
- `pubDate,desc` is always appended as a secondary tie-breaker sort if not already specified in the request.
- Pass sort criteria as `sort=property(,asc|desc)`. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sorting criteria in the format: `property(,asc|desc)`. Default direction is `asc`. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

Supported property names:
- `pubDate` (or `pub_date`): Publication date (default: `pubDate,desc`)
- `saveAt`: Date saved
- `title`: Video title
- `author`: Channel / author name
- `channelId`: YouTube Channel ID
- `videoId`: YouTube Video ID
- `description`: Video description
- `id` / `_id`: Record ID. Allowed sort fields: [pubDate, saveAt, author, title, channelId, videoId, description]

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of RSS entries

default.description: Default error response represented as RFC 7807 Problem Details

get.summary: List LLM Generation Metadata

Retrieves a paginated list of LLM generation metadata records tied to inspections with rich filtering, text search, token counts, cost ranges, and date range filtering.

### Sorting Behavior:
- Default sort: `saveAt,desc`.
- `saveAt,desc` is always appended as a secondary tie-breaker sort if not already specified in the request.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sorting criteria in the format: `property(,asc|desc)`. Default direction is `asc`. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

Supported property names:
- `saveAt` (or `save_at`): Date saved (default: `saveAt,desc`)

- `generationId` (or `generation_id`): Generation ID
- `modelUsed` (or `model_used`, `model`): LLM model name
- `provider`: Provider name
- `finishReason` (or `finish_reason`): Finish reason
- `usage.cost` (or `cost`): Total inference cost
- `usage.totalTokens` (or `total_tokens`): Total tokens consumed
- `usage.promptTokens` (or `prompt_tokens`): Prompt tokens
- `usage.completionTokens` (or `completion_tokens`): Completion tokens
- `id` / `_id`: Record ID. Allowed sort fields: [saveAt, created, generationId, modelUsed, provider, finishReason, usage.cost, usage.totalTokens, usage.promptTokens, usage.completionTokens, serviceTier, isByok]

get.summary: List All Error Logs Across Collections
get.description:
Retrieves a unified, paginated list of dynamic error documents merged from all error collections
(`rss_inspection_errors`, `transcript_fetch_errors`, `transcript_save_errors`, `summary_errors`).

### Sorting Behavior:
- Default sort: `_id,desc` (most recently created errors first, using MongoDB's auto-generated `_id` timestamp).
- Merged error documents are sorted globally by creation time.

### Creation Time Filtering:
- Filter errors via `created.gte` (after), `created.lt` (before), etc.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: `property(,asc|desc)`. Default direction is `desc` on `_id` (creation time).. Allowed sort fields: [_id]

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

200.description: Successfully retrieved merged dynamic error log documents

default.description: Default error response represented as RFC 7807 Problem Details
